newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: KBB sees further expansion in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: KBB sees further expansion in Belgium.

text.p: Retail group NV Koninklijke Bijenkorf Beheer (KBB) said on Tuesday its planned takeover of outlets of Belgian department stores chain Sarma from GIB Group would provide the basis for further growth in Belgium.

KBB's department stores division Hema has four outlets in Belgium and is preparing the opening of more stores there. If the takeover, which was announced earlier today by GIB, succeeds the Sarma outlets will be converted into Hema stores.
"This expansion will raise the number of Hema outlets in Belgium to 25 or 30 by the end of this year," KBB said.
It added that the takeover would also fit GIB's strategy to safeguard the employment of Sarma's staff.
No financial details of the planned takeover were given.
